observations: Inspected full numbered drawing and seven small-component sheets. Exclude explicit acute tips at wing bands, cloud curls, folds and leaf ends, preserving real tiny ear dot, eye whites, wing triangles, finger gaps and the five flower-center dots. Reconnect the fragmented mouth slit, enclosed wing corner, fingertip crescent and two narrow robe details. The upper head's hair and face remain continuous as drawn; the lower face is separate from veil and hands. Flower and geometric right-side border remain independent. Feature names use visible forms and position, not an inferred religious identification. Source pixels and earlier versions remain unchanged.
